name: Family at Home Remake
source:
The remake of FAH has visual improvements and changes in the story and characters, but the principle remains the same; You are a boy named Alonso (Name may be changed) who, along with his mother (Rebeca) and sister (Samantha), go to visit his aunt's house. After spending some time in that house, he realizes that his family has strange behaviors and decides to investigate what is happening.

[From [url=https://salr-games.itch.io/family-at-home-remake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
翻拍版《FAH》在视觉效果上有所改进，故事和人物也有变化，但原则是一样的；你是一个名叫阿隆索（名字可能被更改）的男孩，他和他的母亲（丽贝卡）和妹妹（萨曼莎）一起去拜访他姨妈家。在那所房子里呆了一段时间后，他意识到他的家人有奇怪的行为，并决定调查发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://salr-games.itch.io/family-at-home-remake]Itch.io[/url]]
